flags.description: Server name to use for server certificate validation. If it is not provided, the hostname used to contact the server is used

flags.name: --token
flags.description: Bearer token for authentication to the API server

flags.name: --user
flags.description: The name of the kubeconfig user to use

flags.name: --username
flags.description: Username for basic authentication to the API server

flags.name: --v
flags.description: number for the log level verbosity

flags.name: --vmodule
flags.description: comma-separated list of pattern=N settings for file-filtered logging (only works for the default text log format)

flags.name: --warnings-as-errors
flags.description: Treat warnings received from the server as errors and exit with a non-zero exit code

flags.name: --allow-missing-template-keys
flags.description: If true, ignore any errors in templates when a field or map key is missing in the template. Only applies to golang and jsonpath output formats.

flags.name: --create-annotation
flags.description: Will create 'last-applied-configuration' annotations if current objects doesn't have one

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Must be "none", "server", or "client". If client strategy, only print the object that would be sent, without sending it. If server strategy, submit server-side request without persisting the resource.

flags.name: --filename
flags.description: Filename, directory, or URL to files that contains the last-applied-configuration annotations

flags.name: --help
flags.description: help for set-last-applied

flags.name: --output
flags.description: Output format. One of: (json, yaml, name, go-template, go-template-file, template, templatefile, jsonpath, jsonpath-as-json, jsonpath-file).

flags.name: --show-managed-fields
flags.description: If true, keep the managedFields when printing objects in JSON or YAML format.

flags.name: --template
flags.description: Template string or path to template file to use when -o=go-template, -o=go-template-file. The template format is golang templates [http://golang.org/pkg/text/template/#pkg-overview].

flags.name: --as
flags.description: Username to impersonate for the operation. User could be a regular user or a service account in a namespace.

flags.name: --as-group
flags.description: Group to impersonate for the operation, this flag can be repeated to specify multiple groups.

flags.name: --as-uid
flags.description: UID to impersonate for the operation.

flags.name: --cache-dir
flags.description: Default cache directory

flags.description: Path to a cert file for the certificate authority

flags.description: Path to a client certificate file for TLS

flags.name: --client-key
flags.description: Path to a client key file for TLS

flags.name: --cluster
flags.description: The name of the kubeconfig cluster to use

flags.name: --context
flags.description: The name of the kubeconfig context to use

flags.name: --disable-compression
flags.description: If true, opt-out of response compression for all requests to the server

flags.name: --insecure-skip-tls-verify
flags.description: If true, the server's certificate will not be checked for validity. This will make your HTTPS connections insecure
